scope: Independent read-only derivation from local class driver and production controller source, plus deterministic algebra. No robot access, ROS invocation, calibration measurement or hardware approval.

pupperv3-monorepo/ros2_ws/src/control_bo.evidence: Normal write clamps the requested position in named ROS coordinates when kp>0, then adds the stored homing zero. Read subtracts that same zero. Homing estimates zero from the detected stop and configured homed_position.
copy_actuator_commands defaults use_position_limits=false; do_homing uses this path. The native normal-control diagnostic does not reproduce homing.
Local signs are -1 and static offsets are zero. Forward and reverse transforms are inverse pairs. Bias defined after this transform requires no additional left/right sign flip.

pupperv3-monorepo/ros2_ws/src/pupper_v3_.evidence: Homing stop coordinates and normal position_min/max are distinct; the normal clamp is 0.10rad inside the corresponding model bounds.

pupper_gait_deploy/src/neural_controller.evidence: All position-action actors read the same hardware position state minus fixed policy default. Activation reads that state too. Initial interpolation ends at the fixed activation anchor; actor targets are clamped before the downstream hardware write.

pupper_gait_deploy/src/position_target_s.evidence: Slew state is seeded from bounded measured joints and remains in encoder/controller coordinates. It precedes conversion to physical targets.

pupper-mjlab/src/mjlab/tasks/pupper/mdp/.evidence: At this source snapshot the custom locomotion observation reads true joint_pos; later independent per-step observation noise does not reproduce a persistent calibration offset.

pupper-mjlab/src/mjlab/tasks/tracking/tr.evidence: Tracking explicitly sets biased=True for its actor joint-position term.

pupper-mjlab/src/mjlab/tasks/pupper/targ.evidence: Matched slew action seeds q+b and converts its bounded controller target to physical target by subtracting bias.

coordinate_definition.q: True physical joint angle in the named ROS joint orientation, relative to the correct mechanical zero.
coordinate_definition.r: Encoder angle after inverse SPI sign/static-offset conversion, before homing-zero subtraction.
coordinate_definition.z_true: Correct zero in that same encoder coordinate, so r=q+z_true.
coordinate_definition.b: z_true-z_estimated, a constant per-joint calibration error. This is not the raw motor-coordinate sign convention.
coordinate_definition.u: Requested controller position in measured encoder/ROS joint coordinates.

derived_contract.actor_joint_position_relative: q+b-policy_default_joint_pos, for both locomotion and tracking position actors
derived_contract.constant_bias_velocity: Constant b contributes no velocity term; measured velocity equals true velocity under this offset-only model.
ordering: Actor affine target and controller clamp
Optional position-target slew in measured coordinates
Normal hardware driver clamp in measured coordinates, when kp>0
Subtract bias to express the physical target
derived_contract.target_interval: A driver encoder interval [L,U] becomes physical target interval [L-b,U-b]. Do not re-clamp after subtraction to the unshifted driver interval.
derived_contract.mechanical_limits: True model joint stops stay fixed. A command clamp limits the target, not observed physical state or dynamic overshoot.

initialization.seed: Activation reads q+b; with no intervening clamp, sending that seed back gives physical target q.
initialization.anchor: The policy default/selected clip anchor remains fixed. Do not add b to it or to reference tables to cancel the observation.
initialization.slew: Slew reset first clamps q+b. The exact initial-hold identity therefore applies only when the measured seed lies inside the selected bounds.
initialization.native_transfer_bookkeeping: Keep previous controller-target metrics in q+b coordinates, separate from the physical delay-buffer seed q. Lab6 owner was notified and corrected this bookkeeping.

training_implication.finding: The reviewed custom locomotion actor omits the persistent joint encoder bias, although position targets subtract it. Tracking actor includes it. This is a training/deployment observation mismatch.
training_implication.narrow_repair: Use measured biased joint positions in the affected actor observation through an explicit versioned opt-in contract; preserve historical training and checkpoint provenance.
keep_unchanged: Fixed policy default and reference poses
Privileged critic terms unless explicitly intended to share actor sensing
training_implication.not_a_substitute: Independent per-step uniform observation noise does not establish coverage of the missing persistent observation/action coupling.

algebra_checks.scope: Illustrative exact coordinate identities, not physical validation.

limitations: Installed Pi driver/controller/firmware/calibration identity remains unknown.
The reviewed +/-0.015rad experiment range is a chosen training stress range, not a measured distribution of this robot homing error.
The uniform independent per-joint bias model does not cover state-dependent backlash, compliance, encoder drift, sign/scale faults, or correlated homing errors.
Normal-control semantics do not reproduce homing, which intentionally bypasses position limits.
The source command-limit margin does not establish actual physical clearance, safe stopping, or bounded physical joint excursions.
This report does not establish or modify actuator/IMU latency or stochastic noise models.
Existing immutable hardware comparison package remains unchanged; these hashes identify the reviewed source snapshot.
